ranking_policy: Agent-security trend scan for 2026. Rank papers by cross-topic coverage, relevance to the security of tool-using AI agents (attacks on an agent's control of its own actions, defenses that hold, measurements of either, and the human/organisational consequences of deploying agents), citation signals, and recency. Papers matched by several security or consequence topics rank highest, so the corpus favors work that connects a mechanism to an impact.
